Names the rationale explicitly: the 2026-07-19 OOM where one inline orchestrator reached roughly 17.8 GB and was killed by the kernel.

It fails closed (allowlist, not denylist) and is the value the loop retains per spec. selftest check 'WARP-0909 receipt keeps only allowlisted keys (no result/transcript leak)' and 'WARP-0909 receipt carries the summary fields present (spec/kind/ok/status/commit/proof_digest)' prove the projection over a realistic bulky outcome (scripts/selftest.py).
